Vemec S.r.l. is a leading Italian manufacturing company founded in 1983, specializing in the design and production of mechanical components and assemblies for heavy machinery. Operating across multiple production facilities covering over 23,000 square meters in Northern Italy, the firm provides advanced metal machining, laser cutting, and structural fabrication services. With more than 40 years of experience, Vemec delivers high-precision engineering solutions to diverse industrial sectors, including mechanotextiles and heavy equipment manufacturing
